newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gengold details March qtr output forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Gengold details March qtr output forecasts.

text.p: Gencor Ltd said on Monday that output, excluding Oryx Mine, would rise slightly in the March quarter, above the 10 tonnes of the December quarter.
Including Oryx, Gencor produced 10,455 kg in the three months to end-December, versus 10,104 kg in the preceding September quarter.
Gencor said the average grade, excluding Oryx, in the March quarter was likely to hold its December quarter levels of around 5.9 to 6.0 gram/tonne.
March quarter output at Beatrix Mines Ltd would remain steady around the 3,844 kg in the December quarter. Grade appeared to be on a slight negative trend.
Oryx Mine's March quarter gold production looked set to soar to just under 550 kg from the 419 kg in the December quarter and grade appeared to be on the rise but at a slightly slower rate.
Production at St Helena Gold Mines Ltd in the March quarter was seen falling slightly under the 1,400 kg produced in the December quarter.
Evander Gold Mines Ltd was expected to produce slightly less gold this March quarter than the 4,792 kg of the December quarter.
